title: QA Pilot Training Sim Advisory Review
description: Schema for a read-only advisory review summary of a training simulation case/result. Reviews are advisory-only, carry no authority, expose no apply/train/bridge behavior, and require Owner decision for any downstream action.

source_sim_id.description: References the training sim case this review summarizes.

summary.description: Read-only advisory summary of sim case and result observations.

advisory.description: Must be true — review output is advisory-only.

no_apply_path.description: Must be true — no packet application path exists in review output.

no_train_behavior.description: Must be true — no model-training behavior exists in review output.

no_bridge_behavior.description: Must be true — no MCP bridge behavior exists in review output.

no_mutation_authorized.description: Must be true — packet mutation is not authorized by review output.

no_cross_project_write.description: Must be true — cross-project write is not authorized by review output.

owner_decision_required.description: Must be true — Owner decision required for any downstream action.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of review generation.
